paite: Dawnna nem in thangpaihna aheimang a; himahleh thusia in hehna atokthou hi.
Mipil lei in theihna agen dik a; himahleh mihaite kam in haina asungkhia hi.
TOUPA mitte mun chiteng ah a-om a, hoih lou leh hoih veng gige in.
Lei damthei hinna sing ahi; himahleh huai a kilawmlouhna kha sukkhapna ahi.
Mihai in apa bawlhoihna amusit a; himahleh kuapeuh salhna limsak in pilvanna amu hi.
Midiktat inn ah gou tampi a-om; himahleh migilou summuhna buaina ahi.
Mipil mukte'n theihna aphalh a; himahleh mihai lungtang in huchibang in ahih kei hi.
Migilou kithoihna TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh mitang thumna akipahna ahi.
Migilou lampi TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi; himahleh kuapeuh diktatna zui a-it hi.
Lampi mangngilhmi a ding in bawlhoihna haksatak a-om a; huan kuapeuh taihilhna mudah asi ding hi.
Sheol leh Abaddon TOUPA ma ah a-om uh; mite tate lungtangte bangzah phet in atamzaw diam aw?
Musitmi'n salh a om nuam asa kei; mipil kiang azuan kei ding hi.
Lungtang nuam in mel kipak abawl a; himahleh lungtang dahna ziak in lungsim apuakkham hi.
Theihsiamna nei lungtang in theihna azong; himahleh mihaite kam haina in akivak hi.
Gimthuak nite tengteng hoih lou ahi; himahleh kuapeuh lungtang kipak in ankuangluina anei gige hi.
TOUPA launa toh tawmchik ahoihzaw, huai agou thupi leh buaina sang in.
Itna omna a anteh-louhing nek ding ahoihzaw, bawngtal thau leh huai a muhdahna sang in.
Mithangpai in kinialna atokthou a; himahleh kuapeuh heh hak in kinakna adamsak hi.
Thadah lampi ling daikalh bang ahi; himahleh mitang lampi lamlian abawl ahi.
Tapa pil in pa kipak abawl a; himahleh mihai in anu amusit hi.
Pilna bei a ding in haina nopsakna ahi; himahleh theisiammi in apaina atangsak hi.
Thupha omlouhna ah, thiltupte avuaksuak; himahleh thupha gen tamna ah hihkip in a-om uh.
Akam a dawnna ah mi'n nopsakna anei; huan ahuntak a thugen hoih hi na mah e.
Mipil a ding in hinna lampi apaitou a, nuailam a Sheol a kipan apaimang theihna ding in.
TOUPA'N kisathei inn azungkalhkhiak ding; himahleh meithai gamgi ahihkip ding.
TOUPA a ding in lunggel giloute akihhuai a; himahleh lungsim siangthoute thugen ama kipah lam ahi.
Punna a duhgawl in ama inn ahihbuai a; himahleh kuapeuh thilpiak hua ahing ding.
Midiktat lungtang in dawng ding in akisin a; himahleh migilou kam in thil hoih lou asungkhia hi.
Migilou a kipan gamla ah TOUPA a-om a; himahleh midiktat thumna aza hi.
Mitte vakna in lungtang akipaksak a; huan tanchinhoih in guhte athausak hi.
Hinna taihilhnate ngaikhia bil mipilte lak ah a-om gige ding.
Kuapeuh bawlhoihna nial in amah kha amusit ahi; himahleh kuapeuh taihilhna ngaikhia in theihsiamna amu hi.
TOUPA kihtak pilna thuhilhna ahi; huan zahtakna ma ah kiniamkhiakna apai hi.
